title: Socket watchdog: 15 s health check, 60 s silence, back-off capped at 30 s with jitter (row 11 match)
reference_behaviour: The live socket is checked every 15 s, reconnected after 60 s of silence, with a doubling delay capped at 30 s plus a random spread; a clock line tells when prices were last updated (bundle-findings 6.1).
ours: REQ-114 AC-1 to AC-3 copy the same 15 s / 60 s / 30 s cap pattern with jitter (jitter size differs, see RD-065).
